steps.text: IO needle.
Conscious patient: consider priming the extension set with 1 mL of 2% lidocaine, then slowly infusing 0.5 mg/kg of 2% lidocaine through the IO needle (maximum 40 mg). Allow to dwell for 1 minute.
Flush with 10 mL of normal saline.

procedures.name: Set up for intubation
procedures.source: REMSA Protocols: Airway Management (7. Endotracheal intubation, 8. Post-intubation management)
procedures.notes: Sedation (ketamine) and post-intubation fentanyl/midazolam are in the protocol but not in the truck inventory.

steps.text: Preoxygenate. Apneic oxygenation (high-flow oxygen by nasal cannula) may prolong the time before hypoxia during the attempt.
Prompt suctioning of soiled airways before the attempt.
Paralytic: rocuronium 1 mg/kg.
Video laryngoscopy when available; otherwise direct laryngoscopy.
Initial tube size: adult females 7.5, adult males 8.0. A bougie may help, especially when video laryngoscopy is unavailable.
Plan for an alternate airway if intubation is unsuccessful: supraglottic airway.
Inflate the cuff with minimum air to seal the airway.
Confirm placement with waveform capnography.
items: In-Line End-Tidal CO2 (ETCO2) Filter Line Set

steps.text: Secure the tube with tape, twill, or a commercial device.
Manual ventilation, or mechanical ventilation if available.

procedures.name: Set up IV, deliver fentanyl, and monitor
procedures.source: REMSA Protocols: Pain Management Including Procedural Sedation (6a, 7, 12); Universal Care (monitoring, vascular access)
procedures.notes: Fentanyl is not in the truck inventory.

steps.text: Monitoring: continuous pulse oximetry, cardiac rhythm, and waveform capnography (required if administering opioids).
Establish vascular access.
Fentanyl 1 mcg/kg IV (maximum initial dose 100 mcg).
If indicated by pain assessment and vital signs allow, repeat after 5 minutes.

procedures.name: Check and treat low blood sugar
procedures.notes: Treat if blood glucose is 60 mg/dL or less. D5 500 mL is also listed in the protocol but is not in the truck inventory.

steps.text: Check blood glucose.
Conscious with a patent airway: oral glucose 15 g.
Unconscious or unable to protect airway: dextrose IV in incremental doses until mental status improves (D10 250 mL preferred).

procedures.name: Chest pain: 12-lead, aspirin, IV, nitro
procedures.notes: Avoid nitro if a phosphodiesterase inhibitor was used in the past 48 hours.

steps.text: Oxygen as appropriate, targeting 94-98% saturation.
Acquire a 12-lead EKG within 10 minutes.
Aspirin 324 mg, chewable non-enteric-coated preferred.
Establish IV access.
Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL; may repeat up to three times every 3-5 minutes if SBP is greater than 100 mmHg or MAP is greater than 65.
